content.title: Only 2 couples from Age of Attraction are still together after filming ended
content.text: Age of Attraction just came to an end on Wednesday, March 25. During the finale, we saw four of the five remaining couples leave the show together on Commitment Day with the promise that they would make things work in the real world after filming ended. We even saw one couple get engaged! Well, months later, it's clear that not all of those relationships have withstood the test of time, distance, and a myriad of other factors, of course. While we don't have any insight about the reasons some of these couples broke up, we do know how many couples are still together and how many couples broke up after filming. Thanks to a new interview with the cast from Entertainment Tonight, we know who those two couples are. (ET has since pulled the interview and set it to private on YouTube.)Age of Attraction. (L to R) Libby Vodicka, Andrew Wheeler in episode 105 of Age of Attraction. Cr. Courtesy of Netflix © 2026Libby and Andrew and Vanessa and Logan are still together In the video clip, Leah Woolfolk, Theresa Demaria, Libby Vodicka, and Vanessa Drozda were asked if they were still in a relationship with the person they left the show with. Obviously, we saw Chris Dahlan break up with Leah in the finale, so they clearly broke up. Of the three women left, only Libby and Vanessa raised their hands. So, we know Libby and Andrew Wheeler and Vanessa and Logan Goodrid are still together. Vanessa and Logan are actually still engaged. They were the only couple to get engaged on the season. We didn't even know that was an option, but clearly, Logan had some surprises in his pocket that we, and Vanessa apparently, didn't know about heading into the finale. In the interview, we also learn that Logan decided the night before to propose. Andrew opened up about where his relationship stands with Libby. "We're working on it," Andrew said. "That's our next step." So, that means two couples who tried to make things work broke up after the season. Theresa and John and Pfeifer and Derrick broke up after filming Unfortunately, we learned that Theresa and John and Derrick and Pfeifer are not together. In the clip, we heard from Derrick and John about why their relationships didn't work out. After confirming they were no longer together, Derrick revealed that Pfeifer had just started her career, but he hinted it wasn't just her job that caused the breakup. "That distance, she just started a new career, and honestly, probably some influence, honestly, from her friends," Derrick said. "And, I knew that was going to be a challenge, you know, that we had to get through, or not. Though, at the end of the day, we're still on really good terms. We still talk, so that's important." As for Theresa and John, we did hear John open up, and he claimed that their breakup was due to their age differences in some regard. "Unfortunately, age did impact it at the end," John said. "I figured it's not a big deal unless she makes it a big deal. I didn't care; I appreciated our connection. I appreciated how she made me feel in such a chaotic environment that we all experienced." "We dated for like six months after the show," John continued. "And, just being out in public, it just wore, wore, wore, wore, wore, wore, wore on her, and that's what ended up breaking us up." Ouch. Well, there you have it. Two couples are still together trying to make things work, while two others broke up. We're likely going to hear even more about those relationships on the Age of Attraction season 1 reunion, which will be released on Nick Viall's podcast, The Viall Files, instead of Netflix, on April 1 at 7 p.m. ET / 4 p.m. PT. Stay tuned for more news about Age of Attraction! Hopefully, the ratings are good enough to scoree a second season of the hit Netflix reality TV series.
